name: Ricotta
author: SuperDuperDeou on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 500 ml of milk (or if not using whey, 2 l of milk)
6 g of citric acid (contained in 130 ml of lemon juice)

steps: Pour the milk (and/or whey) and the salt into a pot, stir it well, and heat it up to 80°C.
Once the temperature has been reached, add the citric acid (or lemon juice) and stir well. You should already see the citric acid react with the milk/whey.
Pour the ricotta in the cheesecloth and let the whey drip.
Move the ricotta into the cheese recipient.
